description.value:
Requirements You're piloting a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.rulebook-bestiaries.Actor.Hoverboard].

You use careful angling to turn your hoverboard into a makeshift shield. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Raise a Shield] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Shield Block] with your hoverboard, and you're wielding your hoverboard as long as you're piloting it. Your hoverboard is a commercial-grade shield that grants a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and can be improved.
